items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I did a side with Jack

ctx.x: Okay, that was the Casa Loma Band that he took over.

Yeah. He say, 'I'm looking for a sound, you know. I haven't got it yet.' And he got it. He finally got it. Like it was in the picture. He was looking for something, and he found it. And he called us up and say, 'Come on, listen to this.' We say, 'Man, that's beautiful.' But in the meantime, we were working with Jack, (Unaudible) -- Robbins' music -- Shapiro

items.q: I took Jack Dupree over there. We made one -- I made one side... Jack Dupree and Mr. Bear, 'Lonely Road Blues'.

trouble was, when we did this date with Mickey Baker and all those people -- the first time I did this date, everybody wanted to know who was the star. Because I had been doing recording dates. You know, I was writing for -- See, I was writing for a lot of dates, you know. And so when I went down to do -- When Bob Rolontz got this label, I took Jack Dupree over there.
